_comment: Sync manifest — drives both sync-manager.ps1 (GUI) and sync-guidelines.ps1 (CLI). Both must produce identical project outputs.

backups._comment: Created by `sync-guidelines.ps1 -Backup` (New-DatedBackupDir). Declared unconditionally rather than only on a -Backup run: an ignore line for a directory that does not exist yet costs nothing, and a conditional entry is the one forgotten on the run that needs it. Before this section existed the entry lived nowhere, so a -Backup sync left an untracked directory — and the `clean-tree` step of the pre-push gate fails on an untracked directory.

guards._comment: The guard scripts a project must EXPOSE as an npm script. The mirror delivers the files, but a file nobody runs is a control that exists only in a directory listing — so this is the one home for 'which controls a project must have'. Declared rather than derived from the guards' own `@tier`, because a tier says WHEN a guard runs, not WHERE it is meaningful: `check-links.js` guards the guidelines tree and is meaningless in a project, while `check-doc-breadth.js` is a milestone obligation in every project. `check-sync-drift.js` verifies each project's package.json runs every file named here, by file and not by script name — the doctrine maps each step to the project's own names.

starters.description: Project constitution — primary AI agent rules, all inline. Created once; never overwritten on re-sync (user owns this file).
Project overview — the single home for what-this-is, structure, and quick start. Replaces the deleted AI_CONTEXT.md / ARCHITECTURE_INDEX.md.
Detailed technical reference for all subsystems — loaded on demand
GitHub Copilot pointer file — redirects to AGENTS.md (single source of rules). Created once; never overwritten on re-sync.

skills._comment: `_skills/` is a FILTERED mirror, not a whole-directory copy: only the skills that fit a project's stack are delivered, and the decision lives in one place — global-configs/scripts/lib/plan-skills.js. So `check-sync-drift.js` verifies each project against the PLAN that selector produces (every planned skill present and byte-identical, nothing left behind), never against this whole source corpus. A whole-corpus hash comparison would report every project as drifted by construction, because 12–16 of 20 skills is the correct delivery.
skills.agentsMdSectionBody: Skill files live at `_skills/<name>/SKILL.md` — the Agent Skills standard layout. Only the skills that fit THIS project's stack are copied; load one when its trigger matches the current task.

vscodeCopilotInstructions.comment: Always prefer the project-local AGENTS.md — it is self-contained and always present after sync.
